task: Deliver real-filesystem quota enforcement latency measurement for CNCF readiness Phase 5 ('Scalability & performance benchmark') from issue #81: add Air-Gap E2E Stage D2, scripts/e2e/measure-enforcement-latency.py harness, unit tests, and CI runner integration without touching production Go code.

events.summary: Readiness item Phase 5 'Scalability & performance benchmark' from issue #81: add Air-Gap E2E Stage D2 (scripts/e2e/measure-enforcement-latency.py, unit tests in scripts/e2e/test_enforcement_latency.py, and scripts/e2e/run-airgap-e2e.sh hunk) to measure real-filesystem quota enforcement latency across xfs, ext4, and btrfs. Not touched: production Go code, quota logic, argv construction, RBAC, docs, or other workflows.

docs/cncf-readiness-draft.md Phase 5 "Scalability & performance benchmark" is PARTIAL because the only published numbers (BenchmarkWatchPVsEventStorm, CI run 42712214584: 0.572/0.782/1.045/1.787 ms per PV at 100/500/1000/2000) use a stubbed quota.CommandRunner; nothing measured quota application latency against a real filesystem.

Air-Gap E2E Stage D2 creates N PVs (default 100, env E2E_LATENCY_PVS) on the real prjquota filesystem (xfs/ext4/btrfs matrix), records per-PV latency from PV creationTimestamp to first observed nfs.io/quota-status=applied (1s timestamp resolution, 0.5s polling), prints p50/p90/p99/max and total as JSON between BEGIN/END markers and in the step summary; asserts correctness only (all applied within 180s, enforced-limit-bytes annotation, five sampled native hard limits) and cleans up before Stage E.
bash -n and shellcheck on scripts/e2e/run-airgap-e2e.sh clean; python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/e2e -p 'test_*.py' ran 6 tests OK; make ci-selftest 83 tests OK. No production Go code changed.
events.scope: Air-Gap E2E test harness and offline test suite; static validation only. No production Go code changed.

events.summary: Air-Gap E2E run 42744896380 on PR head fc9c8dd passed Stage D2 and Stage E on xfs, ext4 and btrfs; N=100; totals 39.45 s (xfs), 65.12 s (ext4), 39.303 s (btrfs); five sampled native hard limits matched per filesystem (97656 KiB xfs/ext4, 100000000 bytes btrfs). Also record honestly that the first CI run failed all three legs at Stage D2 with "JSONDecodeError: Extra data" (kubectl dry-run prints concatenated JSON documents) and was fixed in 1a3929a + fc9c8dd.
